gpu_memory.scope: Whole-device 100ms samples, including display and other processes; not isolated model memory.

engine_metadata.postprocess: native one-to-many head and class-aware external NMS, IoU 0.7
engine_metadata.preprocess: Ultralytics BGR to RGB, letterbox to 640x640, float32/255
engine_metadata.capacity_note: Nano variants are not parameter-count or FLOP matched across model generations.

tracker_metadata.tracker_compute: CPU NumPy association; no ReID network
tracker_metadata.buffer_policy: Common rounded one-second track buffer for all three trackers
tracker_metadata.comparison_scope: Pinned Ultralytics implementations on identical postprocessed boxes; native association thresholds; not full paper reproductions
tracker_metadata.threshold_note: ByteTrack/BoT-SORT high=.25 low=.1 new=.25 match=.8; TrackTrack high=.6 low=.25 new=.7 match=.7

strict.scope: Clip/direction/time-only one-to-one agreement with source-only AI review. Not identity-verified accuracy; ambiguous source events excluded from references, retained in source review.

plus_0_5s.scope: Clip/direction/time-only one-to-one agreement with source-only AI review. Not identity-verified accuracy; ambiguous source events excluded from references, retained in source review.

measurement_notes: Source decoding + detector + tracker + counter + JSONL logging; model load, 5 warm-up calls, rendering and encoding excluded.
Detector and tracker timed with CUDA synchronization. Batch 1, fixed 640x640, FP32 and TF32 disabled. Native YOLO letterbox versus RT-DETRv2 warp preprocessing differs; model capacity is not matched.
YOLO26n uses one-to-many head with external NMS in this common Ultralytics adapter; this is not the default end-to-end NMS-free configuration.
Our GPU jobs run sequentially. Desktop display and other processes are not isolated; NVML whole-device samples and per-process torch allocator peaks are distinct.
Tracker-only runs replay identical ordered YOLO26n rep01 boxes and scores. ReID OFF, GMC none, 24-frame lost buffer. Native association thresholds differ; no tuning on these clips.
Three repeats quantify runtime variation; they are not independent source samples. AI source-only annotations are not human-consensus or full identity ground truth.
Absolute occupancy is unknown. Track ID totals are not unique people; no HOTA/IDF1/recall claimed.
